Overview
========

This section describes the model conventions that every public API follows.

.. toctree::
   :maxdepth: 2

   model

The GRGL and GRAPP projects provide the underlying graph representation and
matrix-free genotype operators:

* `GRGL concepts and Python API <https://grgl.readthedocs.io/en/latest/>`_
* `GRAPP overview and API <https://grapp.readthedocs.io/en/latest/>`_
